question: whether a load forgets a wing target

struct_fields.name: target_id_type
struct_fields.comment: The type half of the persistent id of the ship this one last shot at; with +0xBC, the remembered target CSubUnit::PickTarget keeps from hour to hour. Cleared by CCombatant::AddUnit and for a ship that cannot shoot. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-seabattle.md, section 4. **Not saved**: a save written during a battle in the air, 2026-11-10, holds no such key, so that a load forgets it is inferred; a reload was not watched (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 10).
struct_fields.evidence: A wing block of a save written while the battle ran holds no target key. The original was not reloaded and watched.
